items.text: Fixed a crash caused by starting the game as certain characters (such as BOSS) with all curses enabled.
Fixed a crash which would sometimes occur while using the Boomerang or Record weapons.
Renamed "Camera-mouse focus" (in the game settings menu) to "Camera-crosshair focus."
Tweaked the descriptions of "Camera-crosshair focus" and "Camera-player focus."
Corrected typos with some medals.: Small one with a couple crash fixes, that's all!

(Hopefully) fixed a crash which would occur upon reaching the main menu for some players. This is another crash I had trouble recreating myself, so it could take multiple patches to get this one fully ironed out.
Added an option under audio settings that lets you disable weapon firing sound effects.
Added two more treasure rooms to the Shrine floor to encourage visiting it pre-loop (it *is* intended as a shortcut to the dream route, after all).
Boosted health for all phases of the new final boss.
Last phase of the new final boss's body segments now take slightly less damage than the head. The head still takes full damage.
Damage numbers now show up as "0" for Dog Chunks and Tentacle Chunks.
Slowed down Dog Chunks's charge attack.
Luis now starts with the "Holster" item to provide extra clarity that he starts with an additional weapon slot.
Fixed the "Breath Mint" using the wrong sound effect when fired.
The fake crash message in the Abandoned Set no longer appears when playing the game on a controller.
Fixed Luis's icon appearing in the Curse menu when Luis hasn't been unlocked.
Corrected errors in some of Roselia's item descriptions.
Removed some debug features that were accidentally left in the game (whoops).

Last patch caused a new crash to emerge which would happen whenever you'd retry a run after dying. This hotfix SHOULD amend that issue. I wasn't really able to replicate the crash myself, but I removed the line of code that was causing it to happen. That should've done the trick!
In the "No More Running" challenge, you can now move whenever enemies are not on screen.
Added an option to disable certain effects used by the new floors under Video settings > Effects settings. Disabling these may help improve performance on some hardware.
Decreased Oko's HP (both with and without wool).
Updated Cordelia's sprite on the Curse select screen to use her correct skin tone.
Corrected the name of the "Uselessness" challenge being wrong on "The Swimmer" achievement on Steam.
Increased the hitbox height for Fuji's gloves (and all glove-type weapons).
Fixed a bug which caused the wrong music track to be played on the main menu under certain circumstances.
Increased the low end of Cybil's shop prices (from $50 to $100) and removed the $150 option.
Fixed "Chicken Hat" and "Hand Mirror" causing the game's difficulty to *not* reset upon getting a game over.
Lowered the chance of duplicate chests occurring *without* "Aporia."
(Probably) fixed banned items spawning during challenges, such as "Ball 'n' Chain" spawning during "No More Running" and softlocking your entire run.
Added the new music video as a playable video from the movie gallery (unlocked by clearing the dream route with every character).
Optimized shader effects used on the new floors, this should hopefully boost performance a bit for people with lower-end hardware.
Hidden achievements now show up as a series of question marks in the challenge book. Should hopefully make it clearer how to unlock some of the new challenges.
Lowered the volume of explosions when multiple explosions are happening at once.
Fixed Axel's hidey hole not spawning in the Shrine, Dream, Mindscape, Nightmare, and Ruined Estate floors.
Fixed a bug which caused cultist shops to never spawn on main floors.
Updated all music tracks used for the new final boss. I had accidentally used slightly earlier versions of them before, whoops.

Fixed the new final boss's checkerboard attack only creating a limited number of explosions.: I'm gonna continue working on optimizations, but hopefully this patch makes the game perform a little better for everyone who has been experiencing lag in the new levels.
Increased Pierrot Deux's HP a slight amount.
Fixed the "Erase save data" and "Rebuild save file" options being invisible.
(Probably) fixed a crash which would sometimes occur during level transitions. I wasn't able to replicate this one, but I corrected a block of code that was likely causing it.
(Also probably) fixed the final boss's second phase sometimes getting stuck in walls. Again, I couldn't replicate this one either but I added some code that should prevent this from happening.
Fixed a number of new items not having a visible item description in shops.
Reduced some effects during the new final boss fight to hopefully boost performance.
Fixed Lydia continuously losing money during the last segment of the new final boss fight.
Extended the lifespan for Golden Wormy so they shouldn't disappear within a second of you entering a room.
Fixed Tentacle Chunks's ground attack being layered beneath blood effects.
Slightly lowered the volume for the two new title tracks.
Fixed "BTGO" freezing the game when used in the kitchen.

Removed a duplicate earlier version of a Roselia painting that accidentally stayed in the game.: Next I'm gonna be working on a performance patch to address some of the lag issues with the new levels and boss fights. Expect that somewhat soon!

releases.displayName: GOOD NIGHT!: Dead Estate's final update is here!

items.text: I had a LOT more written here originally, but for brevity’s sake I think all I really have to say here is thank you all for sticking with this project and seeing it through to its end with us. I’m sure that if you’re reading this you wanna know what’s in the update, so here it is!

New ending route with 3 full floors!: Includes three full-fledged new floors: the Dream, Mindscape, and Nightmare; including unique enemies, bosses, and environments along with a new final boss and ending cutscene.
New optional floor: “The Shrine”!: An additional full-sized floor completely separate from the new route!
70 new items!: Brings the game’s final item count to 300 (from 150 on initial Steam release or 69 on original Newgrounds release).
31 new weapons!: Brings the game’s final weapon count to 150 (from 67 on initial Steam release or 26 on original Newgrounds release).
10 new challenges!: A whole new set of challenges, mostly related to the new floors. One for each character with a nice reward at the end of each one!
D-costumes!: A brand new set of entirely beach-themed costumes unlocked by clearing the new challenges! No spoilers here, beat the challenges and find out!
“Falling off the Face of the Earth”

Chunks mutations: Upon looping or when playing on painful mode, Chunks can now mutate into several different possible forms upon death which are much fiercer than usual: Dog Chunks and Tentacle Chunks.
Small additions, balance changes, and adjustments
Filia, the Curse shopkeeper, now sells powerful weapons in exchange for Chunks Medallions.
Added an inventory screen to the pause menu which displays all of your items in one neat place.
Added an additional menu under “Extras” for some new cutscenes.
Added new artwork and music to the gallery and music sections.
Added "Remove corpses" under game settings, which when enabled causes enemy corpses to fade away and vanish after a few seconds.
Added “Show items” under video settings, which allows you to toggle the item display at the bottom of the UI.
Added functionality to support binding multiple inputs to one action.
You can now bind actions to mouse buttons 4 and 5.
Moved all options related to gamepads to a submenu under control settings.
Moved "Input accessibility" from game settings to control settings.
Updated all of Cordelia’s in-world sprites to be consistent with her canon skin tone.
Digby no longer loses combo time while waiting in challenge rooms.
Changed the unlock requirement for Digby.
Changed the unlock requirement for Cordelia’s B costume.
Re-recorded and updated voice lines for Lydia, Roselia, Diavola, and Cybil at the request of the voice actress.
Lowered the price of the Map item.
Lowered the chance for Gold Ring to activate.
The Vault is now a chance-based item.
Reworked the Needle: there's now only a 20% chance to take double damage if your HP is over 2 and it deals way more damage to enemies.
Lengthened the vulnerability window for Gold Mask.
Looping now increases enemy and boss HP by a greater amount.
Gold Worms now vanish after a few seconds.
Chest and Weapon Box Mimics no longer despawn upon exiting the room.
Toned down the effects of flooded floors on all enemies.
Significantly lowered the chance for Mimic Chests to spawn on loops.
You can now view the differences between difficulties from the character select screen.
Raised coin drop rates on Painful, Nightmare, and X Must Die difficulties.
Raised red pot spawn rates on Painful and X Must Die difficulties.
Lowered the chance for buffed enemies to spawn on Painful, Nightmare, and X Must Die difficulties.
Chunks no longer instantly chases you on X Must Die difficulty and he no longer "locks in" on the player.
Massive Attack: Longleg, Wormy, Worm Egg, and Mutant Blue are no longer affected by resizing.
Nerfed BOSS's "Curse of the Maniac" so it further decreases your fire rate.
Gamepads now have unique input icons in tutorials, etc,.
Gamepads now allow variable jump height.
The game now remembers what costumes you have equipped.
Treasure and weapon rooms no longer appear as secret rooms on loops.
Overhauled map generation to be significantly faster and smoother.
Cleaned up some code related to medals to make some screens (including the main menu) load much faster.
Heavily optimized the loading sequence at the start of the game; the loading screen has been entirely removed since it's no longer necessary.

The map no longer becomes invisible after multiple loops (both this and the above change were originally a result of the game’s difficulty increasing by 1 every time you looped. Now, map visibility and treasure/weapon room visibility are based on your starting difficulty rather than looped difficulty).
You now receive more Chunks Medallions based on how many times you looped on a normal run (previously you only received bonus Chunks Medallions per loop on true ending runs).
Added some more tips to the level transition screen.
Swapped the "level loading" text with a proper icon during level transitions.
Added cute little crows to the Balcony and Dark Mood Woods floors.
Also added tiny spiders on the ground to a handful of floors.
Added some new easter eggs, be on the lookout!
Updated the requirement for unlocking the "Dead Estate" medal; it is now unlockable by clearing the game on any difficulty, not just normal.
Toned down fire particle effects on the "Ultra Hot Pepper" item.
Toned down fire particle effects on all burning projectiles.
Lowered the opacity on all fire particle effects.
Changed the game's window icon to a zombie's face.
Added some new posters and portraits to the mansion.
Fixed a crash which would sometimes occur while holding the flamethrower weapon.
Fixed a crash related to minimizing the game when a cutscene begins.
Fixed a bug which required the player to unlock “Some Time to Reflect” and “Disarmed” in order to unlock “Milkbar Lads #1 Fan!”
Capped the amount of screen shake caused by increasing Digby’s combo.
Fixed a bug where some text would display incorrectly after leaving and re-entering certain rooms.
Fixed an error which caused BOSS to use some of Jules’s sprites for her damage animations.
Fixed a bug which allowed players to start challenges with curses activated.
Fixed a bug where the "Super Glue" item would not work correctly after quitting and continuing a run.
Fixed a bug where "Chrysus Medallion" would effectively allow the player to live forever even at 0 HP.
Fixed a crash caused by switching your weapon several times after continuing a run.
Fixed tips occasionally appearing off-screen during floor transitions.
Fixed the game momentarily freezing when opening certain menus in Assignment Anya.
(Potentially) finally fixed the white room softlock in Assignment Anya (this one has been really hard to replicate so bear with me).
Fixed potions being infinitely reusable if your inventory is completely full in Assignment Anya.
Fixed Axel high-jumping when performing charged axe throws while using a gamepad.
Fixed "The Abomination" medal being unlockable on normal difficulty.
Corrected a typo with the Chunks medallions popup.
Removed one little stray pixel from Cordelia's shop art on the Upper Story.
Fixed some tooltips for Curses in Filia's shop menu being way too tall.
Fixed one of Axel's B-costume walking animations being shirtless.
Fixed the can't buy/leave voice lines in shop menus overlapping by spamming.
Fixed Chunks Medallions being visible from the character select menu after clearing the normal ending rather than after clearing the true ending.
Updated some of the normal ending polaroids to correct their line art color.
True ending credits now correctly list Katarina C. as Cybil's voice actress.
Fixed all of Dr. Cordelia's voice lines being too quiet.
Fixed rain sound effects getting spammed while entering the Balcony or Dark Mood Woods.
Flame particles and light particles no longer spawn while the game is paused on burning and dark floors respectively.

…not in terms of new content for Dead Estate, anyways. It pains me a little to say it, but this update really is the end of the line for this game. We’ve done pretty much everything we wanted to do with Dead Estate; it’s all out there now. There are some things we still have left to do with this project, but just don’t expect any new additions. We’re sailing on uncharted waters now, but this update should hopefully demonstrate that we have a firm idea of where we plan on going.

Our work on this game officially started in August of 2020. Over the course of the following four years, we released the game on Newgrounds in a much smaller form, then we launched it on Steam with close to triple the content of the original, and then we launched six free content updates for the game. I don't think any of us expected us to stick with Dead Estate for as long as we did, but I can happily say that none of us regret the time we devoted to making it happen. Thanks again for joining us throughout all of Dead Estate’s development, we hope you’ll join us again for our next game!

This collection of 3 games will keep you entertained for 100s of hours! This is a "Complete the set" bundle, meaning you'll still get the discount without needing to re-purchase any games you might already own.
Picayune Dreams, a bullet heaven + bullet hell surrealist action fantasy
Schism, an incredibly deep gun-modding bullet hell RPG that takes inspirations from both traditional and action roguelikes.

The Milkbar Lads and myself first connected over Newgrounds. A site I've always considered my home on the internet. So it should come as no surprise that I've continued to work from Newgrounds-borne talent!

Croak Crusader: Spawn of the Spore Spectre is a grapple-based action platformer, and will be released entirely for free! Coming from Tunaware, you can play the demo on Steam today! Be sure to add it to your Wishlist so you don't miss out on the full release.
And on a more personal note. Thank you all so much!!

Dead Estate was the first game published by 2 Left Thumbs. That joint risk between the Milkbar Lads and myself paved the way for this entire publishing enterprise. Being able to pay that forward, supporting more and more indie devs, has been an absolute dream!

My heart goes out to this team who have poured everything into Dead Estate, Newgrounds where it all started, and to all the fans who have allowed us to support this game for all these years. We hope you have an absolute blast playing, and that our story inspires a new generation of devs.
Hey everyone, this is Jack! After about a year of work on this update, we're pleased to announce that we'll finally be able to share it with all of you on October 28th!

The Goodnight Update is gonna be the final content update we release for Dead Estate EVER, so we really wanted to take some time and go all-out on this one. We ended up working on this update for almost as long as the game's initial Steam release and we ended up with a lot of content. I know it's been a while since Assignment Anya came out, so at least a few of you are probably eager to find out what, exactly, is in this update.

In short, Goodnight includes four new full-size levels (three of which make up a new ending route), 70 new items, 31 new weapons, a new set of costumes, 10 new challenges, mutations for Chunks (you'll find out what this means when you play a looped or hard mode run), and a lot of other small additions and adjustments. I'm hesitant to share many screenshots or footage of the update since I want to keep as much of it as a surprise as possible.

It feels a little melancholy finally moving on from this project once this update is out, but it's been a great four years and we're ready to finally start working on some new games. We hope you enjoy the new update!
